AC-S4-11.1.detail: Planted extra-record content (model memory, an invented quotation, a custom-pack law, a fact in the prompt, inferences resting on them) never renders; it is counted and logged by hash. The model is reachable in Chambers only through the record-only path.

AC-S4-11.2.detail: Every rendered statement carries RECORD, LAW or INFERENCE_FROM_RECORD and at least one locator (document, page and paragraph with the exact excerpt; or authority, chunk and excerpt); inferences carry their bases' locators.

edition-gating.detail: A signed JUDICIARY licence enables the Chambers surface and hides advocacy-only screens; every other edition sees no Chambers screen; the host (not the menu) refuses what is hidden; the air-gap switch stays on; pilot-court constraints are configuration. The edition-to-feature map and prices stay with B-S4-22 (Q-S4-06).
